flora: Radiolarian test (microscopic porous silica skeleton with radial symmetry)
Geodesic lattice (intricate, interlocking hexagonal silica framework)
Central capsule (stylized soft-tissue inner core within the silica shell)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; Microscopic scale; Organic mineral architecture; Texture of fine white porcelain or frosted silica; Avoid jewelry, Christmas ornaments, or macro glassware; Highly detailed but with the soft, rounded edges characteristic of the project's visual identity.

visual_logic.composition: Scientific quadrant tile: Top-Left: a full spherical skeleton with radiating spines; Top-Right: extreme close-up of a geodesic honeycomb lattice; Bottom-Left: a cross-section showing the inner capsule; Bottom-Right: several abandoned skeletons settling like dust on a chalky surface.
visual_logic.ground: A clean, high-contrast backdrop of deep indigo water or fine white chalk silt, reinforcing the deep-sea pelagic setting.
visual_logic.lighting: Soft, multi-directional 'studio' lighting that reveals the complex internal layering and the 3D relief of the silica lattice.
